text:
marta: SLO alert - euw1 hosted-infer gateway p99 timeouts jumped to ~6.8s, alerting and customers reporting 502/504s. CS ticket #8792 and #8793. Anyone able to triage? :warning:

sam-oncall: I'm on it. Oncall now — switching to triage mode. Which routes/customers are hitting this?

marta: Most errors from /v1/generate and /v1/chat. Customer notes: short requests (100-200 tokens) time out after ~15s. Some requests return 502 almost immediately.

opsbot: [ALERT] hosted-infer.euw1.gateway.p99_latency > 6s (10m) — triggered 4076543208.

jess: Pulling logs + traces now. Quick log query (Loki):
```
{env="prod", region="euw1", service="gateway"} | json | status >= 500 | line_format "{status} {path} {upstream}" | count_over_time(10m)
```
seeing a concentrated spike between 4076543000-4076543200, primarily upstream failures from model-proxy instances: model-proxy-euw1-[a-f0-9]{6}.

ben-sre: Traces: many root spans present but missing the gateway->proxy child spans. Looks like a trace gap between gateway and the pool. When spans exist they show `connection reset by peer` and `recv timeout`.

marta: Support asked if token rotation could've caused auth failures. CS logs show some 401s earlier but the majority are 502/504.

sam-oncall: Running quick repro with curl to reproduce:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-large","input":"hello"}' \ 
  https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate --max-time 20
```
result: sometimes immediate 502, sometimes hang then 504 at ~15s.

jess: Checking rate limiter metrics and connection pools. Gateway backend queue depth spiked, and proxy pool reported many aborted handshakes. Query: `sum(backend_queue_depth{region="euw1", service="gateway"}) by (route)` shows /v1/generate top.

ben-sre: Correlation with a recent deploy? I see a small deploy to model-proxy-euw1 ~20 minutes before the alert. Deploybot shows restart_count on a couple of hosts.

opsbot: deploybot: rollout completed for model-proxy-euw1 v3.4.2 at 4076542005. Several instances restarted during rollout.

marta: Could be transient pool thrash after rollout + some client retry storms. CS says some customers reported spikes at 12:37 UTC.

sam-oncall: Immediate mitigations: 1) pause new deploys to model-proxy-euw1, 2) add temporary routing to fallback model instance pool (redwood-fallback-1) for high-error customers, 3) increase gateway client-side retry to reduce hammering on restart. Implementing 1 & 2 now.

jess: Flipped rollout pause, routing rule added for customers in escalation list -> redwood-fallback-1. Also increased connection idle timeout on proxy side from 10s -> 20s for this pool (temp).

support-bot: Forwarded CS tickets #8792, #8793 to eng-sre with customer logs.

ben-sre: Post-mitigation check: p99 latency dropped to ~2s within 3m of routing change. Error rate for /v1/generate went down by ~70%. Traces still show some gaps but decreasing.

sam-oncall: Good. Next steps: 1) dig into why deploy caused connection resets (kernel/network? graceful shutdown), 2) add more robust handshake/backoff in proxy, 3) add synthetic trace coverage for gateway->proxy spans, 4) run post-incident scale test to reproduce. I'll open an incident and assign owners.

marta: Logged incident INC-2026, assigned to ben-sre for root cause and jess for observability follow-ups. Adding CS update to affected customers now.

jess: Saved dashboards and example queries to incident board: https://console.redwood.dev/incident/INC-2026/dashboards (link for reference). Also capturing a log sample for postmortem:
```
{"ts":4076543102, "service":"gateway", "path":"/v1/generate", "status":502, "upstream":"model-proxy-euw1-3f2a1b", "err":"connection reset by peer"}
```

ben-sre: Suspect improper connection draining during rollout + some NAT table exhaustion on a few hosts. Will check kernel conntrack and proxy drain hooks.

sam-oncall: Thanks all. Will keep the incident channel updated. If anyone sees regression revert routing. :thumbsup:

marta: Thanks team — CS notified customers that we applied a temporary routing fix and are investigating root cause.

[sidenote] This thread to be used for triage only; detailed timeline + follow-up to live in the incident doc.
